title: Budget for Estate Upgrading Programme for Private Estates
what_it_is: Budget for Estate Upgrading Programme for Private Estates

sections.label: Project budget and programme pace
sections.summary: Each project's average budget is about S$20 million, and the programme's pace depends on available resources and coordination with other agencies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The average budget for each project is about S$20 million.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The pace of the programme will depend on the resources that are currently available, and we also have to coordinate with other Government agencies in terms of planning and upgrading works to minimise inconvenience to the residents and the public.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: MND will invite nominations for future projects once we have the timeline for implementation.

sections.label: Project budget and nomination engagement
sections.summary: Each project is about $20 million with no block budget or fixed schedule, and ground engagement for nominations generally works through the CCCs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: As for how much the budget is, I did say earlier that each project is about $20 million.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We do not currently have a block budget for this, but each project is about $20 million.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: As and when the resources are available, financially, manpower or a need, we will then roll out calls for the next project.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, there is no current fixed schedule at the moment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In terms of engagement of the ground for project nomination, we generally work through the CCCs because they do know the demands of the estate better, but there is no reason why we will not inform the current Member of Parliament if there is a need to do so.

sections.label: Factors in upgrading estates
sections.summary: Upgrading as many estates as possible depends on the estate's age, physical characteristics, available resources, and ongoing agency works.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Of course, ideally, we will want to upgrade as many estates as possible.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: But we have to look into the age of the estate, which is just one aspect, and also the physical characteristics there as well as what we can do there physically, plus also resources available, as well as whether there are any ongoing works that agencies have planned for.
